competitorRepeatedOutputs.method: A second actual native browser compression of the same exact source bytes. Generated screenshot and transparency PNGs only were uploaded to four server providers. Licensed landscape used in local Squoosh only. Actual downloads independently decoded with Pillow; hashes/dimensions/RGBA compared with first native output. No encoder-only timing or speed ranking. Two runs per9configurations, not a statistical performance sample.
notes: 11zon transparent: same9793bytes and exactRGBA, but encoded PLTE/tRNS/IDAT chunks differ; file-level determinism not established for this case.
11zon first download click opened an advertisement overlay; visibleClose dismissed it then outputs saved.
FreeConvert link click did not produce a reliable download event; documented browser downloadMedia on actual observedDownload links saved both outputs.
TinyPNG initial file chooser locator used stale plural accessible name, timed out before upload; fresh singularChooseFile chooser succeeded.
No authentication, fees, CloudConvert quota retry, security bypass or captcha solving.
No timings retained: UI/tool overhead and intermediate observation delays prevent defensible stage timings in this repeat run.
Provider-side caching/deduplication is opaque; repeated actual outputs do not prove fresh server encoding each time.

staticLogoOptimization.method: Existing pinned Oxipng 2.3.0 single-thread WASM at levels 2/4/6, optimizeAlpha=false and interlace=false. Independently decode full RGBA and alpha with Pillow; verify dimensions and color-profile/gamma chunks. No resizing, color reduction or new artwork.
